cases.name: create-new-skill
cases.prompt: Add a skill to this repo that reviews Terraform plans before apply.

expect.judge: The response refuses to write skill text before observing a failing case, and plans positive and negative eval cases.

cases.name: retarget-description
cases.prompt: The tech-writing skill keeps firing on non-technical writing requests. Tighten its description.

expect.judge: The response adds the wrong-trigger prompt as a negative eval case and re-runs checks rather than editing the description and stopping.

cases.name: retire-decision
cases.prompt: Is the prose-writing skill still worth keeping now that models write decent prose unaided? Remove it if not.

expect.judge: The response measures with and without the skill before deciding, and keeps the eval cases if it removes the skill.

cases.name: validate-repo-skills
cases.prompt: Check that every skill in this repo is still valid.

cases.name: ordinary-code-change
cases.prompt: Fix the off-by-one in the retry backoff helper and run its unit test.

cases.name: ordinary-doc-edit
cases.prompt: Fix the broken link in README.md.

cases.name: agents-md-edit
cases.prompt: Add a section about our commit message format to AGENTS.md.

cases.name: use-a-skill-normally
cases.prompt: Write the README for this project.
